title: Team Claim
description: A simple Datapack to claim an area between two teams and created by Gapee.
body:
## Main features
 - Two teams in constant conflict.
## Operation
 - When the block in the player's first slot is clicked or throwed, an area nine wide and nine long centralized on the player is secured. If this block is clicked or throwed a second time, the secured zone is withdrawn.
- When a player from the opposing team is in a secured zone, a Weakness II and Highlight effect visible through the blocks is applied.
## Additional features
 - Damage is inflicted when a player is above a stonecutter.
 - Four strings can be obtained when a white wool is set in the manufacturing interface.
